skills_considered.reason: The discovery ledger is owned by other batches; what this reading supports is proposed as commit candidates and in the intake note.
An aggregation or real-world cohort supplies no new therapeutic lever for the reference genotype class; forging hypotheses from it would manufacture a lead.
No compound is newly proposed; cannabidiol is an approved antiseizure medicine and nothing here is sent to BLOCK-1 triage.
Scientists do not touch the four current files; every change is proposed as a commit candidate.
The triples are published in the candidates for a blind auditor; the reader cannot audit their own locators.

group_assessment.weighting: A two-hospital retrospective IESS series (361 patients); WWOX is one row in the genetic group and one word in a discussion grouping. Credible as a denominator; it gives no WWOX allele, course or response. Not a per-author sweep.

queries.query: WWOX AND (infantile spasms OR epileptic spasms OR West syndrome)

field_density.note: 25 PubMed records tie WWOX to spasms; this source adds no per-patient WWOX data.

multihop.note: 39 references enumerated; the WWOX patient is the authors' own, no WWOX reference is cited for it.

retraction_check.result: Checked 2026-10-03 via PubMed metadata (get_article_metadata): publication types ['Journal Article']; no retraction, expression of concern or correction listed for PMID 39850204.

entries.proposition: 165 cases were classed unknown, 58 of them never genetically tested.
entries.snippet: 165 cases (45.7%, including 58 that were not genetically tested) were classified as unknown

entries.proposition: Seizure control is a four-level clinical scale.
entries.snippet: complete remission (clinically seizure-free), effective (>50% reduction of seizures), poor effect (<50% reduction of seizures), and ineffective (no improvement or worsening of seizures compared to prior status)

entries.proposition: Treatment is analysed only as ACTH versus non-ACTH.
entries.snippet: The treatments were categorized into ACTH treatment (n = 242) and non-ACTH treatment (n = 119).

entries.proposition: The authors place WWOX in an enzyme-synthesis grouping.
entries.snippet: enzyme synthesis-related: NARS1, MECP2, UBA5, CLU4B, WWOX, RAB3GAP1, and IARS2
This study lacked long-term follow-up data for patients with IESS.
